prose: Dutch-language page: Bert Hubert's list of his public talks ('Praatjes'), mostly on digital autonomy, sovereignty and cloud dependency, for Dutch institutions (Kiesraad, Autoriteit Persoonsgevens, Tweede Kamer, Belastingdienst, universities and conferences). Not article content - a talks index. (The wiki keeps content in English; the page itself is in Dutch.)
